errors.evidence: The description states that the sectors are arranged in descending order of values, but they are arranged in ascending order, from the lowest value (10.9%) at the top to the highest value (82.6%) at the bottom.
The description claims the horizontal axis has a label "%", but there is no visible axis label in the figure. The percentage signs are part of the data labels for each bar.
The description claims the horizontal axis has intervals of 10%. The figure does not show any axis scale, tick marks, or intervals.
